bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; p=deploy-postgres-1; docker inspect "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 41; q="SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id AND d.source_type='announcement' WHERE d.telegram_message_id=4639 AND t.chat_id=-1002373696859 AND t.message_thread_id=1695 AND a.kind='recruitment'"; c=$(docker exec "$p" psql -XAt -U gace -d gaybbs -c "$q" 2>/dev/null) || exit 42; test "$c" = 1 || exit 43; q2="SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public_post_drafts w JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.owner_user_id=w.owner_user_id JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id WHERE w.module='announcement' AND (w.data->>'screenMessageId') ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND d.telegram_message_id=4639 AND t.chat_id=-1002373696859 AND t.message_thread_id=1695"; n=$(docker exec "$p" psql -XAt -U gace -d gaybbs -c "$q2" 2>/dev/null) || exit 44; if test "$n" = 0; then echo TARGET_POST_FOUND_DM_SCREEN_NOT_IN_ACTIVE_DRAFT; exit 11; fi; if test "$n" = 1; then echo TARGET_POST_AND_DM_SCREEN_FOUND; exit 0; fi; exit 45
